residual_findings.title: Author identity uses world ownership (narrative_worlds.owner_creator_id) rather than works.creator_id; revisit if Work→KeyBlock provenance linkage is introduced
residual_findings.scope: nexus42/CLI: author gate for edit/delete resolves via world ownership not works ownership
residual_findings.note: KeyBlocks are World-scoped (entity-scope-model §5.1.1) and kb_key_blocks has no works FK. The owner_creator_id resolution is the canonical ownership path per entity-scope-model §1.2. Reads (list/show) are local-first (no gate); edit/delete gate on world owner. Edit re-runs ValidationMode::Novel via SqliteKbStore::with_validation_mode.
residual_findings.closure_note: V1.52 T-A P2 fix-wave (commit da4caab4 on feature/v1.52-work-keyblock-provenance-and-essay-profile): added require_world_or_work_owner auth gate. Source Work owner can edit/delete KB items (provenance via kb_key_blocks.source_work_id). When source_work_id is set, auth gate checks EITHER World owner OR source Work creator. Spec overlay entity-scope-model §5.5.7 documents provenance contract.

residual_findings.title: kb_adopt not wrapped in a single SQLite transaction (data integrity gap; recoverable orphan)
residual_findings.scope: crates/nexus42/src/commands/creator/world/kb.rs:472-488 (kb_adopt: insert_key_block + mark_confirmed as two non-atomic operations)
residual_findings.note: Failure modes: (1) insert succeeds, mark_confirmed returns Err → orphan KeyBlock + still-pending promotion row; (2) insert succeeds, mark_confirmed returns Ok(false) → misleading error message + orphan. Fix: wrap both calls in pool.begin() transaction; if either fails, ROLLBACK. The current hermetic test double_adopt_is_rejected does NOT cover the race between insert_key_block and mark_confirmed — add a regression test that mocks mark_confirmed failure to assert the orphan is not created.
residual_findings.closure_note: V1.50 T-B P1 fix-wave: kb_adopt now does pool.begin() → insert_key_block_in_tx + mark_confirmed_in_tx → explicit tx.rollback() on !flipped or error before any commit. Misleading error message replaced with 'The transaction was rolled back; no orphan row created.' New regression test kb_adopt_failure_rolls_back_insert pre-flips the candidate and asserts zero orphan KeyBlock rows after rollback. Cross-corroborated by qc2 (security) + qc3 (reliability) re-review.

residual_findings.title: reject audit log path uses internal work_id under Works/<work_id>/... instead of documented work_ref (path convention drift)
residual_findings.note: Spec §5.5.4 mandates retention in Logs/kb/rejected/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<extract_job_id>.md. Current code resolves work_id (numeric internal PK) and writes to Works/<work_id>/...; should resolve work_ref (user-facing identifier) and write to Works/<work_ref>/Logs/kb/rejected/. Fix: use work_ref not work_id for the filesystem path; validate work_ref exists before write.
residual_findings.closure_note: V1.50 T-B P1 fix-wave: kb_reject calls resolve_work_ref_for_log before mark_rejected. Helper returns Err (and aborts) if work_id missing, works row absent, or story_ref NULL. write_rejected_log now takes work_ref and writes under Works/<work_ref>/Logs/kb/rejected/ (log body still records both work_id for audit and work_ref). 2 new regression tests: kb_reject_writes_log_under_work_ref_path + kb_reject_fails_when_work_ref_missing.

residual_findings.title: idx_kb_extract_jobs_promotion_status_work covers (status, work_id) but list_pending_for_world query filters on (status, world_id) — index unused for documented purpose
residual_findings.note: Index does not cover the dominant list path (which filters on world_id). For V1.50 scale (10-100 pending rows per world) this is sub-millisecond and not a hot path, but the index is functionally unused. Fix: add idx_kb_extract_jobs_promotion_status_world (promotion_status, world_id, created_at); remove or rename the unused index. Migration comment also needs correction.
residual_findings.closure_note: V1.50 T-B P1 fix-wave: DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_kb_extract_jobs_promotion_status_work; CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_kb_extract_jobs_promotion_status_world ON kb_extract_jobs (promotion_status, world_id, created_at). Trailing created_at gives index-ordered scan with no filesort. Migration comment fully rewritten. New regression test pending_list_uses_world_id_covering_index uses EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN to assert the planner picks the new world_id index.

residual_findings.title: Heuristic extraction defaults all candidates to block_type_guess='character' (LLM extraction deferred)
residual_findings.note: Heuristic (capitalized noun phrases) cannot distinguish character/location/organization. Authors correct on adopt via `creator world kb adopt`. LLM extraction deferred from V1.50 OUT-B O13 (write-time) and now in scope at V1.51 T-A P0 (review-time + finalize-time) per V1.51 compass §0.1 #7. New `nexus.llm.extract` capability replaces heuristic.
residual_findings.closure_evidence: Closed by plan 2026-06-18-v1.51-llm-extraction (branch feature/v1.51-llm-extraction). nexus.llm.extract capability + LlmExtractTask shipped; quality_loop::extract_kb_candidates_for_review now invokes the LLM pathway when a worker is available (heuristic retained as no-worker fallback). kb_extract_jobs gains llm_confidence + llm_source_quote columns (migration 202606180006). adopt surfaces confidence + source_quote (cli-spec §6.2G). Tests: capability::builtins::llm_extract::tests::* (11), tasks::tests::llm_extract_task_* (4), quality_loop::tests::candidate_from_llm_json_* + block_type_mapping_* (5), kb_extract_jobs_migration::v151_* (4), novel_review_master::review_master_llm_path_writes_llm_payload + review_master_llm_path_is_idempotent + review_master_no_registry_falls_back_to_heuristic (3), creator_world_kb_adopt::adopt_succeeds_on_llm_extracted_candidate + adopt_json_output_includes_llm_metadata (2).
